title: Hytale scoped architectural repair with native multipart validation and isolated-save deployment
summary: Native isolated-save, multipart and selective-record deployment method technically tested for repair and authorised full reconstruction. v001 visual result was rejected by user; v002 reference-led replacement technically passes but still awaits user visual acceptance.
problem_description: Reconstruct an authorised monastic complex to architectural guides while preserving unrelated world data, original save and existing core mods. New asset pack and its enable are deliberate scoped configuration changes.
context: Blackridge reference-led replacement: 15 static custom model types, 60 persisted Adaptive Surface placements, 33 obsolete bed records explicitly removed, 8 new beds persisted. No Computer Use or native client screenshot validation.
constraints: Only authorised Working Copy and explicitly approved reconstruction scope
Preserve village, farmhouse, fields, dry canyon and original save
No core/gameplay mod changes; new static architectural pack enable is scoped
Never equate technical checks with visual acceptance

solution_versions.description: Build in a frozen full clone with the same enabled mods; verify actual models, fillers and rotations; apply previewed bounded edits; audit geometry and routes; reopen a native-record-merged deployment package before installing one verified region file.
changes: Force all planned furniture roots into the placement list even when their final ID equals the original root
Clear affected original multipart objects before installing architecture and furniture
Close wing roof envelopes after stairs and restore supported lantern brackets after later clearing phases
Use native IndexedStorageFile with ChunkUtil.indexColumn; preserve original non-block entities and original block-component records
Validate every untouched chunk record byte-for-byte and every other live save file hash
advantages: Preserves unrelated world data and installed configuration
Root/filler failures become observable and repairable
Technical correctness separated from visual approval
disadvantages: Programmatic traversal is not an actual player movement test
Native palette cannot literally reproduce every reference material
Current storage implementation and model IDs are version-specific
test_results: 32/32 key destinations and 22/22 ground-floor room zones reachable
Post-restart zero planned block/furniture mismatches, zero declared roof gaps, zero unsupported new light roots
18 changed chunk records; 1006 other region records identical; 13 original block entity records preserved
5547 other live save files unchanged; original save and mod configuration untouched

metrics.reliability: All recorded programmatic assertions passed; user visual review outstanding

solution_versions.description: Reference-led authorised full reconstruction in a verified isolated save, retaining the native multipart/persistence/scoped-record deployment method while adding a small static architectural model pack. User visual approval remains pending.
changes: Derive new volumes, foundations and detail geometry from supplied architectural boards instead of keeping the rejected enclosure/building template
Add 15 native static blockymodel types with a single 256x128 atlas; preflight all custom and Adaptive Surface IDs
Apply multipart dirty-footprint closure across previous and new objects; reapply intersecting unchanged roots after clearing
Remove only the explicit 33 obsolete monastic bed component records; preserve other source entity data and persist 8 new beds
Reopen staging server, verify final geometry/routes, merge 20 exact records while preserving 1004 unrelated records
Install only merged region, new asset pack and its explicit config enable; verify every other preexisting live file
advantages: Separates technical safety from unproven visual acceptance
Dedicated sub-block architectural geometry without gameplay code
Explicit entity removal policy supports demolition without resurrecting old objects
disadvantages: No native client POV/nightlight/physical collision acceptance yet
New static pack must remain enabled for custom details
test_results: 23/23 navigation goals and all free cells in six ground zones reachable
60 Adaptive Surface placements and 8 bed entities persisted after restart
20 changed records, 1004 unrelated records identical; 5546 other existing save files identical
Live region checksum verified; user visual approval pending

metrics.reliability: Technical assertions pass; visual requirements are not declared validated
metrics.compatibility: Observed Hytale 0.6.8 and Adaptive Surface 0.9.3 only

transferability: The isolation, native-model inspection and scoped-diff method is reusable. IDs, bounds, rotations and native storage version must be revalidated on another world/build.
